name: spec-table-01
title: Spec Table 01 - A Capability's Limits, Its Units And Its Conditions
description: A capability's limits as a real table: what is measured, its value, its unit and the condition it holds under, grouped into caller-named bodies with a row-group header each, and a summary band of figures underneath. Every value is a node the caller composed, the unit is a string beside the value rather than part of it, and the Block derives nothing, infers no unit and rounds no number.
